original.title: 2009.0475: Parlamentarische Initiative RK-NR. Vorübergehende Erhöhung der Zahl der Richterstellen am Bundesverwaltungsgericht / Initiative parlementaire CAJ-CN. Augmentation temporaire du nombre de postes de juge au Tribunal administratif fédéral

classification.source_level_rationale: The record is a direct transcript of a parliamentary debate with a speaker identified and the date of the session expressed.
classification.resume: This document is a parliamentary initiative concerning a temporary increase in the number of judge positions at the Federal Administrative Tribunal, recorded during a session of the Council of States in autumn 2009. It includes a speech by Alain Berset and is part of the video recordings of the Council of States debates. The item was accessioned under the reference 2010/219 in the Swiss Federal Archives.
